edges.reason: Constructor forwards the untrusted deployer msg.sender into _setAdmin, granting permanent admin rights.
changeAdmin is protected only by the ifAdmin modifier comparing msg.sender with _admin().
upgrade is guarded by ifAdmin which compares the untrusted msg.sender to the stored admin.
proposeTo relies on the ifAdmin modifier for authorization.
prolongLock relies on the ifAdmin modifier for authorization.
proposeToAndCall relies on the ifAdmin modifier before performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
cancelUpgrade relies on the ifAdmin modifier for authorization.
_fallback rejects only the admin msg.sender; every other caller reaches the delegatecall.
newAdm parameter flows into the ADMIN_SLOT write performed by _setAdmin.
newLogic parameter flows into proposeTo.
newLogic parameter flows into proposeToAndCall.
Caller-supplied calldata is passed directly into the delegatecall of an arbitrary target.
newLogic parameter flows into _setNextLogic.
block_ is added to PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT with unchecked assembly add, allowing overflow of the lock.
account parameter is used for the extcodesize check in _isContract.
logic_ is the target of the delegatecall that executes external code inside the proxy.
Local pb holds the sum that is stored without overflow protection.
Local logic value is written into LOGIC_SLOT, permanently changing the implementation.
Local logic value read in cancelUpgrade is re-queued as the next logic.
Local size holds the extcodesize result returned by _isContract.
Local proposeBlock is written into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
Local nextLogicBlock is written into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
Logic address returned by _logic() is passed to _fallback and then to _delegate.
_logic() result decides whether proposeTo sets logic directly or queues it.
_logic() result decides the branch taken in proposeToAndCall.
LOGIC_SLOT is read by _logic().
ADMIN_SLOT is read by _admin().
NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT is read by _nextLogicBlock().
PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT is read by _proposeBlock().
upgrade reads the pending logic from NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
_setNextLogic writes the proposed logic into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
_updateBlockSlots writes NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_updateBlockSlots writes PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
_setAdmin writes ADMIN_SLOT through assembly, transferring all proxy privileges.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin to apply the new admin address.
Constructor calls _setAdmin to initialize the admin.
upgrade performs the assembly sstore that replaces LOGIC_SLOT.
proposeToAndCall executes a delegatecall to the caller-supplied target with caller-supplied data.
_delegate executes the unchecked delegatecall to the logic contract.
_fallback delegatecalls the logic contract with no reentrancy protection or gas limit.
fallback routes every call into _fallback and then the delegatecall.
receive routes plain ether transfers into _fallback and then the delegatecall.
_setNextLogic calls _updateBlockSlots after the delay checks.
proposeTo calls _updateBlockSlots when setting logic on an empty proxy.
proposeTo delegates to _setNextLogic when a logic already exists.
proposeToAndCall calls _updateBlockSlots when setting logic on an empty proxy.
proposeToAndCall delegates to _setNextLogic when a logic already exists.
When LOGIC_SLOT is zero proposeTo writes it immediately, skipping the timelock delay.
proposeToAndCall also sets LOGIC_SLOT immediately on an empty proxy, skipping the delay.
_proposeBlock value gates whether _setNextLogic is allowed to queue a new logic.
_nextLogicBlock value gates whether upgrade may activate the pending logic.
prolongLock accumulates the caller value into the local propose block variable.
cancelUpgrade writes NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT through assembly, altering the pending implementation.
cancelUpgrade reads LOGIC_SLOT to restore it as the pending next logic.
Code executed by the delegatecall target can call back into the proxy fallback multiple times.
The arbitrarily delegatecalled target can re-enter the proxy before state changes settle.
